name: WARNING: A.1. Original Steak Sauce (Crushed Orange Puree, Raisins & Vinegar)
whyItWorks: Contains crushed orange puree (citric acid), raisin paste, garlic, onion, and intense acetic acid vinegar. The potent acidity irritates gastroduodenal and ileal ulcerations, while the fructans spark colonic spasms.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid A.1. sauce on steaks. Use a drizzle of garlic-infused olive oil and coarse sea salt for authentic flavor.
